Frequently Asked Questions
Is Steve AI free?
Yes. You can use Steve AI’s free AI Video creation tool plan to create and download videos at no cost. You get monthly credits to try text to video, prompt to video, and other features before upgrading for more downloads and premium options.
Why is Steve AI better than any other AI Video creation platform?
Many tools offer video creation, but users consistently rate Steve AI as the best AI Video creation platform for its ease of use, value for money, and quality of output. We’re also proud to be a 5-star rated platform on Product Hunt. Besides, It’s designed for beginners to pros, with fast results and high-quality outputs in minutes.
Is my data secure with Steve AI?
Yes. Steve AI prioritizes privacy and security with global standards like GDPR compliance, ISO 27001 certification, and third-party risk management through CyberGRX — so your content and projects are protected.
What is Steve AI used for?
Steve AI is an AI Video creation tool used to create videos from text, scripts, prompts, or ideas in minutes. It helps users make text to video, prompt to video, and generative AI videos for marketing videos, explainer videos, learning and development training content, UGC ads, and social media videos, without editing skills or production teams.
What kind of videos can I create with Steve AI?
With Steve AI, you can create explainers, storytelling videos, kids’ content, promo ads, generative videos, animation videos, and even geopolitical news videos.
Does Steve AI have an app?
Yes, there’s an iOS app that enables you to create and edit videos anywhere. Perfect for creators on the go looking to create quick social media content.
What kind of videos can I create with Steve AI?
With Steve AI, you can create explainer videos, storytelling videos, kids’ content, promotional ads, animation videos, generative AI videos, and news-style videos (including geopolitics). It supports everything from text to video and prompt to video to fully animated and faceless video formats.
How to download from Steve AI?
Once your video is ready, click Download. On the free plan, you can generate unlimited videos and get limited local downloads, plus direct publishing to YouTube. Paid plans unlock HD exports, watermark-free videos, and higher download limits.
Why is Steve AI the number 1 AI tool for creating videos?
Steve AI is rated as a top AI Video creation tool because it combines ease of use with high-quality output and strong value. It’s the only platform backed by 3 patents, supports text to video, prompt to video, and generative AI video creation, and is trusted by both creators and businesses with enterprise-grade security and compliance.
